# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 candidate** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 engine update with current upstream servicing fixes. It also refreshes HarfBuzzSharp, uses pointer-based GLES interop signatures, and removes unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m155 and includes its current upstream servicing fixes. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## Platform

- **Unsupported image formats disabled** — RAW and DNG images are not decoded by this release; convert those assets to a supported encoded image format before loading them. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — Updates GLES interop declarations to use native pointer-based signatures for accurate OpenGL ES integration. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and HarfBuzzSharp binding to version 14.4.0.
